Investor protection across the full information journey

Detect synthetic content. Verify against trusted market truth.

01 — Multi-channel intake

Protection follows the investor, not the platform.

Every channel resolves into the same normalized investigation object: media, transcript, claims, identities, URLs, domains and provenance metadata.

01

YouTube & Shorts

Long videos and short-form clips. Deepfake, voice and claim analysis surfaced through the mobile overlay.

02

Instagram Reels

Short-form financial content, captions, metadata, links and suspicious investment claims.

03

Telegram Channels

Channel posts, repeated narratives, high-return calls to action and outbound destination links.

04

WhatsApp / Links

User forwards content to the bot. Suspicious URLs are detonated in an isolated sandbox before guidance is returned.

05
✉

Email & Web

Phishing mail, fake trading platforms, look-alike domains and fabricated news pages.

02 — Deepfake forensics

We do not rely on one “deepfake score.”

The media is decomposed into visual frames and an audio track. Multiple signals are scored independently and then fused into an explainable forensic result.

Frame-by-frame visual inspection

03 — Mobile protection

A simple investor interaction: watch → tap shield → understand risk.

The Flutter experience can use a native Android overlay for the demo. The overlay does not need to alter YouTube itself; it surfaces Market Shield analysis on top of the viewing experience.

YouTube ⌕ ⋮
“Guaranteed 20% returns every month”
⚠ HIGH RISK · 92%

Possible manipulated media + unverified financial claim.

Exclusive investment opportunity
1. Content fingerprintCurrent content is converted into a canonical media / URL identity.
2. Media forensicsVideo and audio detectors run independently.
3. Claim extraction“Guaranteed return”, “SEBI approved”, stock recommendations and entities are normalized.
4. Knowledge matchClaims are checked against trusted sources and known campaign evidence.
5. Explainable verdictUser sees the evidence, not only a probability.
6. Investor actionWarn, verify, ignore, or escalate — before the investor clicks or pays.
Prototype mode: the overlay interaction can be hard-coded for curated demo cases while the backend APIs are progressively connected.
04 — Agentic sandbox

Suspicious links are investigated without exposing the investor.

Email, WhatsApp and social links are opened in an isolated environment. The sandbox follows redirects, inspects page behavior, extracts indicators and produces a risk verdict.

1
Input

URL, email, message, QR destination or attachment.

2
Resolve safely

Fetch in isolated browser/container with no user credentials.

3
Observe behavior

Redirects, scripts, forms, downloads, credential prompts.

4
Extract indicators

Domain, IP, WHOIS, SSL, page title, logos and outbound endpoints.

5
Cross-check

Compare with official domains, broker records and known scam assets.

6
Verdict

Explainable risk score and recommended investor action.

secure-prime-trade-bonus.example/login
PREMIUM TRADING PLATFORM

Deposit ₹25,000.
Get ₹10,000 bonus.

Guaranteed daily profits. Limited slots available.

Activate account
85/100
Likely phishing / fraudulent investment communication
  • Domain is not a verified intermediary domain
  • Guaranteed-return and bonus language detected
  • Credential / account collection flow present
  • Urgency and payment pressure pattern
  • Do not open or enter credentials
05 — Telegram & cross-platform propagation

One post is useful. A connected campaign is more valuable.

Channel content is analyzed for investment claims and outbound URLs, then connected to repeated media, domains, handles and narratives across other platforms.

Alpha Market Calls · 25.6K subscribers
Next 10x stock revealed 🚀
Join before market opens.
tinyurl.example/alpha10x
“Institutional account” users get priority IPO allotment.
⚠ HIGH RISK
Known narrative pattern + suspicious outbound URL + repeated claim across related channels.
Channel / account identityHandle, channel ID, first-seen / last-seen and linked accounts.
Narrative fingerprint“10x stock”, “guaranteed listing”, “institutional account”, “AI trading platform”.
Outbound infrastructureDomains, redirects, QR codes, phone numbers and payment endpoints.
Media reuseSame audio, same visual frames or same source interview appearing across channels.
06 — Curated knowledge graph & live crawler

The verification layer continuously learns what trusted market truth looks like.

The crawler ingests SEBI, NSE/BSE, listed-company filings and trusted intermediary information, then links this authoritative evidence with media, claims, entities and suspicious infrastructure.

07 — Agentic orchestration

Specialized detectors produce evidence; the orchestration layer decides what to do with it.

Each subsystem can evolve independently while the investor experience stays consistent.

Detection agents

Visual deepfake, synthetic voice, lip-sync, generated text and media provenance.

Verification agents

Claim decomposition, registry lookup, trusted-source retrieval and source reconstruction.

Risk & policy engine

Deterministic weighting of model evidence, trusted-source contradiction and known-campaign signals.

AWS deployment

API layer, serverless orchestration, secure sandbox workers, data/graph stores, observability and notifications.
